Container.Name: Glovebox
Container.Overview: Self-hosted vehicle maintenance tracker built around what's due next. Glovebox is a redesigned fork of LubeLogger with a phone-friendly interface: a garage view that flags overdue and upcoming service, a per-vehicle overview with progress through each service interval, rendered markdown notes, an in-app viewer for photos and PDFs, and ntfy push notifications for reminders with an adjustable heads-up before things are due. Cost tracking can be hidden entirely.[br][br]Glovebox reads and writes the same data as LubeLogger. To switch an existing LubeLogger container, keep its path mappings and change only the Repository to ghcr.io/au12/glovebox:latest.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: lubelogger vehicle car maintenance service reminders fuel mileage garage ntfy
Container.Changes: ### 0.2.0 (2026-11-15) - Rebuilt maintenance report: summary page, service history grouped by year, clean printing ### 0.1.0 (2026-11-15) - First release: redesigned garage, vehicle overview and mobile layout - Rendered markdown notes and in-app attachment viewer - ntfy push notifications for reminders with an adjustable heads-up - Option to hide cost tracking

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, photos, attachments, translations and settings. Coming from LubeLogger? Point this at your existing LubeLogger data folder to keep everything.

Config.Name: Sign-in keys
Config.Description: Encryption keys for sign-in cookies. Coming from LubeLogger? Reuse its keys folder so everyone stays signed in.

Config.Name: LANG
Config.Description: Locale for dates, numbers and currency, for example en_US.UTF-8 or en_GB.UTF-8.

Config.Name: Server URL
Config.Description: Optional. The address you use to reach Glovebox, for example https://glovebox.example.com. Used for links in emails and notifications.

Config.Name: Disable account registration
Config.Description: Set to true to remove the Create account page entirely. By default new accounts need an invitation token from an admin.
